market_analysis.market_definition: The fire vehicles industry comprises companies that design, manufacture, and assemble specialized vehicles used for firefighting, rescue operations, and emergency medical services.

market_participants.definition: Companies that build and assemble the complete fire apparatus, including the chassis, body, and integrated systems under their own brand.
market_participants.why_relevant: They are the primary vendors that municipal and industrial buyers contract with to procure custom or standardized fire vehicles.

market_participants.definition: Companies providing critical specialized inputs such as high-pressure pumps, aerial ladders, foaming systems, and electronic controls to the main vehicle assemblers.
market_participants.why_relevant: Their proprietary technology and build quality heavily influence the capabilities and competitive edge of the final fire vehicle.

market_participants.definition: Regional entities that handle local sales, customization requests, maintenance, and aftermarket service for the primary manufacturers.
market_participants.why_relevant: They act as the vital localized link for municipal procurement processes, localized service agreements, and long-term fleet support.

market_analysis.primary_reason: Manufacturer was chosen because the landscape is built around companies that produce and sell a physical, highly engineered vehicle under their own brand name, while component suppliers act as upstream inputs and distributors serve as sales channels.
